candidates.statement: The Australian Red Cross Society has a comprehensive risk governance and accountability framework guided by a three-lines-of-engagement model. The Board oversees risk, sets risk appetite and strategic risk tolerance thresholds, the Audit & Risk Committee focuses on risk and assurance, management owns and operationalises risk controls, and independent assurance is provided through the third line. The framework also emphasises accountability, timely escalation, consideration of stakeholder and community impacts, organisational sustainability, and organisational learning.

The Australian Red Cross Society demonstrates an ethos of accountable, transparent and learning-oriented stewardship through a comprehensive risk governance structure, clear oversight and operational responsibilities, open escalation, consideration of impacts on clients, communities and stakeholders, and independent assurance.

The Australian Red Cross Society implements its risk governance commitments through a comprehensive accountability framework and three-lines-of-engagement model: the Board sets risk appetite and tolerance, the Audit & Risk Committee oversees risk and control effectiveness, operational owners manage risks, second-line functions provide design, review and challenge, third-line functions provide independent assurance, and the Executive Team operationalises the risk management framework. The model also requires accountability, timely escalation, consideration of impacts on clients, communities and organisational sustainability, and learning from experience.
